name: stack
description: STACK — personal life/work system (PWA). No build step: the repository root is what GitHub Pages serves. This file only names the checks (they need playwright, eslint@10 and prettier@3 installed somewhere on NODE_PATH / PATH — CI installs them in a temp dir); nothing here is loaded by the app.

scripts.check: for f in *.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm run unit && npm run lint && npm run verify
